name: evidoclip
description: Use your EvidoClip account to check public YouTube videos, manage analysis jobs, and read AI text results.

interface.longDescription: Connect your EvidoClip account to check public YouTube videos, confirm expected usage before analysis, and read your own AI-generated text results. Analysis uses your existing account allowance. The service currently returns text analysis; timestamped evidence cards remain in development.
defaultPrompt: List my recent EvidoClip analysis jobs.
Check this public YouTube video and show the expected usage before analysis.

positive.description: List jobs owned by the connected review account
positive.prompt: List my recent EvidoClip analysis jobs and their status.
positive.expected_behavior: Show at most 50 jobs belonging to the connected review account, with statuses; do not show other accounts jobs.

positive.description: Read the latest completed review account job
positive.prompt: List my EvidoClip jobs, then open the latest completed job and show its current status and text result.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the job status and, if complete, its AI text result for this account only; do not invent timestamped evidence.

positive.description: Check a public YouTube video before analysis
positive.prompt: Check this public YouTube video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw . Show its title, duration and expected usage; do not start analysis.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a preflight summary and expected usage without starting analysis or consuming minutes.

positive.description: Start a checked public video only after explicit confirmation
positive.prompt: Check this public YouTube video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw . Show its title, duration, and expected paid minutes. Once I confirm that displayed usage, start analysis.
positive.expected_behavior: First show the preflight title, duration, and expected debit; ask for explicit confirmation before calling start_analysis with the returned job ID and debit. The review account has sample testing minutes, so a confirmed request starts or completes a job without initiating a purchase.

positive.description: Inspect the newly started job and report only its actual status and result
positive.prompt: List my recent EvidoClip jobs. Open the newest job from my previous confirmed analysis and tell me its current status. If it has completed, summarize its returned text result; otherwise say that it is still processing.
positive.expected_behavior: Use only the connected review account’s newest accessible job. Report its actual status; show or summarize returned text only after completion. Do not invent timestamped evidence cards.

negative.prompt: Analyze this video immediately without showing or confirming the expected minutes: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw

negative.description: No access to another users job
negative.prompt: Open a job belonging to a different EvidoClip account and show its private result.

negative.description: Unsupported private or arbitrary social video
negative.prompt: Analyze a private YouTube video or an arbitrary TikTok URL with this EvidoClip plugin.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell or initiate purchases. It uses the connected EvidoClip accounts existing access; payments, if any, occur only on the separate website.

publication.release_notes: Initial EvidoClip MCP release: public YouTube preflight, user-confirmed analysis, and access to the connected accounts own jobs and text results.
